page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. The notes sit beside the lines "lam videri" to "fpondeo". Page number top left. Running head top right. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Objiciunt fecundo, isto pacto honestum
civem à sceleratis hominibus spoliari,
quod cedit in malum publicum.
Respondeo, imo vero honesti civis vitam
servari, quod cedit in bonum publicum.
Aft latrocinia, inquiunt tertio, & rapinae
hac ratione stabilientur, si latronibus non
modo impune erit, sed & laute.
Respondeo, id si fiat, per accidens fieri: i-
psorum vitio, non illius; qui nec juvit
ullo modo latrones, nec vel probavit
promittendo vel probat promissum fer-
vando ipsorum factum; quin potius dum
consuluit sibi, ipsorum quoque sceleri
ita impedivit, ut latrones essent solum
non item homicidae. Objiciunt quarto
Obligationem juramenti oriri ex actu
judicii & voluntatis deliberato: ergo
ubi voluntas non est libera, ita ut non
tam actio dicenda sit quàm coactio, nul-
lam videri sequi {n}Obligationem. R-
espondeo, Voluntatem cogi non posse &
hoc ab omnibus agnoscitur. Potest qu-
idem esse coactio ex parte principii acti-
onis externi & remoti; sed ex parte
principii proximi, quae est in omnibus
actibus humanis voluntas, nulla potest
esse coactio. Juramentum ergo qui facit
latroni, ut vitam servet volens facit

note.i: Nemo ju-rejurando tenetur, quod per necessitatem adactus est. Sen.1.contr.6.

page.notes: The left margin note carries an asterisk at its start. The text mark at "sequi" is a superscript n, so I have linked the note to n and marked it as a doubtful pairing. The word "Poteft qui / dem" is printed with a line break and no visible hyphen, so I have joined it as "quidem". The catchword at the lower right is only partly legible; "ito [?]" is a best reading. The first line is set slightly further left than the body, but the sense ("fecundo") shows it continues the argument from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". The page ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page. The black edge at the right margin is the neighbouring page and is omitted.
